title: $$wipe
tagline: Invest in crypto as easily as swiping right. AI-powered, non-custodial, and multilingual—all within Telegram. Bringing Web3 to the next billion.
how_its_made:
We built Swipe using a modern full-stack technology stack optimised for seamless AI-powered crypto investing within Telegram. Here’s a breakdown of how everything comes together:
Frontend
The frontend is built with React and styled using Tailwind CSS for a clean and responsive UI. We use React Query for efficient API interaction and Zustand for state management. Since Swipe operates as a Telegram Mini App, we integrated Telegram’s Mini App framework to ensure a smooth in-app experience.
Backend
The backend is powered by Express.js and Node.js, with TypeScript used across both the frontend and backend to ensure type safety and maintainability. We chose Render for deployment, enabling a scalable and reliable infrastructure.
Database & Authentication
We use Supabase as our database, taking advantage of its real-time capabilities and built-in authentication. For user onboarding, we implemented Google Authentication via Supabase, allowing users to sign up instantly without passwords or complex forms.
AI-Powered Investment Suggestions
The AI-driven investment recommendations are powered by OpenAI. Based on a user’s experience level and risk appetite, our AI suggests crypto opportunities, automating key trading features like stop-loss and profit-taking.
Trading & Wallet Integration
For executing trades directly from Telegram, we integrated Coinbase SDK. The AI’s suggested trades can be executed in one tap using Coinbase HDK (Hybrid Decentralized Key Management). We also use Coinbase WalletX’s create-wallet function, allowing users to manage their crypto without needing external wallets.
Deployment & Team
Both the frontend and backend are deployed on Render. Our team consists of three full-stack developers who have collaboratively built and optimised Swipe to ensure a fast, intuitive, and secure experience for Web3 newcomers and seasoned investors alike.
By combining AI, crypto trading, and a familiar swiping interface inside Telegram, Swipe eliminates barriers to Web3 adoption, making crypto investing effortless, engaging, and accessible to everyone.
